RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: Adult-use marijuana is not legal in Georgia. Possession by anyone who is not a registered patient remains a crime.
RECREATIONAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.gmcc.ga.gov/faqs.
RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of Georgia?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: No. The law does not make the sale, or possession, of all types of marijuana legal in Georgia. Possession of any form of marijuana by an unauthorized person is, and remains, a violation of state and federal law.

MEDICAL.gov_quote: Registered patients and caregivers may possess up to 12,000 milligrams of THC in regulated medical cannabis products.
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.gmcc.ga.gov/faqs.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of Georgia?
MEDICAL.gov_section: Georgia law only authorizes the legal possession of up to 12,000 milligrams of tetrahydrocannabinol ("THC") by a registered patient or caregiver with a valid Medical Cannabis Registry Card.

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: Registered patients may buy laboratory-tested cannabis products at a Commission-licensed dispensary or a licensed independent pharmacy.
MEDICAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.gmcc.ga.gov/faqs.
MEDICAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Georgia?
MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: Registered patients with an active Medical Cannabis Patient Registry Card can lawfully purchase safe, laboratory tested cannabis products at a dispensary licensed by the Commission, or at an independent pharmacy licensed by the Georgia Board of Pharmacy.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: Georgia does not legalize home grow. Registered patients may not grow or possess marijuana in plant or leaf form.
MEDICAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.gmcc.ga.gov/faqs.
MEDICAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to grow cannabis in the state of Georgia?
MEDICAL_GROW.gov_section: it does not legalize the growing, sale, or possession of marijuana in plant or leaf form by registered patients.

sourceNotes: This pass started from https://www.gmcc.ga.gov/home on 2026-09-08 and stayed on gmcc.ga.gov. The FAQ answers all cited questions. Recreational possession stays illegal. Effective July 1, 2026 the FAQ describes a comprehensive medical cannabis market: registered patients may possess up to 12,000 milligrams of THC, buy oils, tinctures, patches, ingestibles, and flower for vaporization at licensed dispensaries, and still may not home-grow or smoke. The FAQ no longer uses the old low-THC-oil-only wording that had kept MEDICAL at NO. History and Purpose still quotes the 2019 Hope Act findings about low THC oil and opposition to recreational use; those are background, not the current possession rule. dph.georgia.gov citations from the prior pass were replaced because that host is not the requested source. gmcc.ga.gov answered 200 to a browser-headed fetch and the excerpts are in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
